description: Defines the 'beerocks_message' class with static methods for message handling, including sending, parsing, and creating vendor-specific messages, as well as printing message types within the 'beerocks' namespace.

classes.name: message_com
classes.description: Provides static methods for message communication, including sending data, parsing headers, creating and adding vendor-specific messages, and printing message types within the 'beerocks' namespace.

methods.name: get_vs_cmdu_size_on_buffer
methods.description: Calculates the size of a vendor-specific CMDU buffer based on a class template.

methods.name: get_uds_header
methods.description: Retrieves the UDS header from a CMDU message.

methods.name: intel_oui
methods.description: Checks if a vendor-specific TLV header matches the Intel OUI.

methods.name: parse_intel_vs_message
methods.description: Parses an Intel vendor-specific message from a received CMDU.

methods.name: get_beerocks_header
methods.description: Extracts the beerocks header from a CMDU message if it matches Intel OUI.

methods.name: add_intel_vs_data
methods.description: Adds Intel vendor-specific data to a TLV.

methods.name: create_vs_message
methods.description: Creates a vendor-specific message of a given type.

methods.name: add_vs_tlv
methods.description: Adds a vendor-specific TLV to a CMDU message.

methods.name: print_cmdu_types
methods.description: Prints the types of a CMDU message.

methods.name: send_cmdu
methods.description: Sends a CMDU message over a socket.

methods.name: forward_cmdu_to_uds
methods.description: Forwards a received CMDU message to UDS.
